whatIs.title: What is Virtari DS?
whatIs.body: Virtari Design System is a source-owned component system built on <1>React</1>, <2>our own headless primitives</2>, and <3>pure vanilla CSS</3>. Install only the parts you need with the <4>virtari</4> CLI, then edit the resulting files directly in your application.

quickStart.title: Quick Start
quickStart.description: Start with a React 18 or 19 application that supports CSS imports. The public CLI installs editable React and CSS source, resolves transitive Virtari dependencies, and adds required third-party packages.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.snippet:
src/virtari/styles             → Tokens, layers, reset, and optional utilities
src/virtari/components         → Editable React components and styles
src/virtari/lib                → Shared helpers and headless primitives
